sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Administration of Employee Share Incentive Plans (ESOP Trusts)

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (Republic of Vanuatu) — VFSC International Companies Registry
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (common law heritage with French civil law influence; unitary national legislation)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), ratified 2018
Tax Information Exchange Agreement with Australia (2010)
Tax Information Exchange Agreement with New Zealand (2011)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (Revised Edition Cap. 222), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act No. 31 of 2011; Part II ss. 5–15 (incorporation and powers), s. 34 (registered office), ss. 36–38 (registered agent), s. 50 (directors); referencing International Trusts Act No. 6 of 1994 (Cap. 251) for the ESIP trust deed
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-01 (Application for Registration of an International Company) together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association and consents of the registered agent and officers
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement. International Companies may issue shares of no par value or of par value in any currency. No escrow account or capital deposit is mandated; the only pre-conditions are payment of the prescribed government registration fee and lodgment of the licensed registered agent's signed consent.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the allotment of 1,000 ordinary shares of no par value to the founding settlor-beneficiary is approved to fund the Company's Employee Share Incentive Plan (ESIP) trust mandate. RESOLVED that the registered office be established at Moana House, Kumul Highway, Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the licensed registered agent be appointed in accordance with Section 34 of the International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992. RESOLVED that [Full Name] be appointed sole director and [Full Name] corporate secretary, with full authority to open bank accounts, execute trust deeds, and do all acts necessary to give effect to these resolutions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Licensed Registered Agent and Company Name Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent (private fiduciary service provider); name clearance processed through the VFSC International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent under a standard engagement letter. The agent submits a name clearance request to the VFSC Registry, submitting one preferred name and two alternatives; the company name must end with 'Limited' or 'Ltd.'. VFSC performs a de-duplication and undesirability check and issues a name clearance certificate. Simultaneously, the agent collects KYC and source-of-funds documentation confirming the ESIP trust administration purpose and the non-financial, exempt status.
required_dossiers: Name clearance request form (Form IC-02) with three proposed names
Registered agent engagement letter
Certified copy of passport of each beneficial owner
Certified copy of proof of residential address of each beneficial owner (utility bill or bank statement, dated within 3 months)
Signed declaration of intended business activity (ESIP trust administration, ISIC 6430 / NAICS 525920)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as undesirable, identical, or confusingly similar to a registered name, the agent re-files within 24 hours using the alternative names or a fresh list; consent letters from the prior name-holder may be lodged where the Registrar deems the similarity acceptable.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-licensed registered agent (preparer); subscriber and initial officers (execution)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Memorandum and Articles in conformity with Schedule 1 of the International Companies Act, fixing share capital at 1,000 ordinary shares of no par value, adopting full-object corporate objects, and stating the exempt and tax-exempt status. The founding subscriber executes the M&A before an independent adult witness; execution may alternatively be effected by a lawful attorney under a notarized power of attorney. Director and secretary consents are signed on the prescribed forms.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Executed signature page of the subscriber, witnessed by an independent adult
Consent to act as sole director (Form IC-03)
Consent to act as corporate secretary (Form IC-04)
Notarized power of attorney (if execution by attorney-in-fact)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries non-standard or restricted-object clauses, the registered agent amends the M&A by executing a supplemental document under s. 6 of the Act and re-certifies statutory conformity; no additional government fee is levied for amendments arising from Registry-side objections.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the Full Application Package to the VFSC Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry (counter or licensed-agent electronic filing portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent compiles the complete package (Form IC-01, executed M&A, officer consents, agent's consent and statutory declaration, name clearance certificate) and files it with the VFSC Registry in Port Vila, remitting the prescribed government fee of USD 250 (or VT equivalent) by bank transfer or agent debit. The Registry allocates a file number and initiates statutory vetting against ss. 5–15 of the Act and the Financial Action Task Force-aligned beneficial ownership requirements.
required_dossiers: Form IC-01 signed by the subscriber
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent letters of director and secretary (Forms IC-03 and IC-04)
Registered agent's signed consent and statutory declaration
Name clearance certificate
Proof of payment of the USD 250 government registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues an inquiry under s. 13 of the Act, the agent files a written response within 14 days supplying the requested clarifications, corrected signatures, notarized translations, or lawful-purpose confirmation; the application is reinstated for review without requiring re-payment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Register Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon successful vetting, the Registrar enters the company in the International Companies Register with a unique registration number, issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the date of incorporation, and returns a certified copy of the M&A together with an extract of the register. The International Company is deemed lawfully constituted as a body corporate as of the date on the certificate and immediately acquires capacity to hold trust assets and administer the ESIP.
required_dossiers: VFSC internal registration entry (no applicant action required)
Certificate of Incorporation
Certified copy of the registered Memorandum and Articles of Association
Official extract of the International Companies Register
Tax-exemption confirmation notice (automatic under the Act)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If clerical errors appear on the certificate (company name, number, or date), the agent files an administrative rectification request with the Registry; the Registrar issues an amended certificate at no additional fee within 2 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Corporate Governance File and Bank Mandate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent, sole director, corporate secretary, and authorized bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The sole director convenes the first board meeting (in person or by unanimous written resolution) adopting the pro-forma first board resolution, ratifying the share allotment, confirming the registered office and agent, and approving the opening of corporate bank accounts and the execution of the ESIP trust deed. The registered agent establishes the statutory registers (members, directors, secretary, charges), the minute book, the company seal, and the beneficial ownership register in compliance with the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Rules.
required_dossiers: Signed First Board Resolution (sole director's written resolution)
Share register and register of directors and secretary
Registered office and registered agent confirmation certificates
Authorized signatory list and bank account mandate forms
ESIP trust deed / employee share incentive plan document (filed in the company minute book)
Beneficial ownership register with VFSC filings, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the company fails at any time to maintain a registered office or registered agent, the Registrar may strike it off under s. 123 of the Act; the cure is immediate re-engagement of a licensed agent and written notification to the Registrar within 21 days, after which the company is reinstated with retroactive effect.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — International Companies Registry; Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade (not applicable for administrative trust activity)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sectoral operating license required for internal or captive ESOP trust administration. If the entity were to offer fiduciary or trust company services to the public in or from Vanuatu, it would require an International Trust Company Licence (or Financial Dealer Licence) under the Financial Dealers Act 2020, granted by the VFSC; this entity is exempt because it administers only its sponsoring employer's employee share incentive plan.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Government of Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Category C — no listed 'undertaking' under Schedule 1 of the Environmental Management and Conservation Act [Cap. 283] and its EIA Regulations; the ESIP trust performs only custodial, bookkeeping, and administrative share-holding functions with no construction, land disturbance, or industrial installation in Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable — the entity generates no point-source wastewater, no VOC emissions, and no regulated hazardous waste; office administration falls under municipal solid-waste collection rules only. If a physical office is maintained in Port Vila, compliance with the Port Vila Municipal Council waste regulations and general building stormwater discharge limits is required.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety: if a physical registered office is maintained, it must hold a current fire evacuation certificate from the Vanuatu Fire Services Division (only triggered where more than 25 persons occupy the premises; a standard commercial office lease is otherwise sufficient). Structural: no load-bearing modifications or industrial structural certification required since the premises are used exclusively for administrative and record-keeping purposes. Occupational: the Health and Safety Act 2020 requires a written workplace safety policy and a basic first-aid kit if any employees are engaged; since the ESOP trust typically operates with zero on-island staff, no substantive clearance is triggered. The registered agent's office already holds the necessary municipal occupancy and civil defense clearances in its corporate capacity.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), operating through the official VRCA portal (www.vcra.gov.vu) as the single agency administering the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 343], the Customs Act [Cap. 145] and residual fiscal duties; international company incorporation and standing are administered separately by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) (www.vfsc.vu) under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: (1) Incorporate an International Company (IC) with VFSC and obtain the Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, and the unique VFSC company number; (2) file the annual return and pay the fixed annual government fee to VFSC (no annual corporate income tax return exists because Vanuatu levies no income tax, capital gains tax, estate tax, withholding tax, or stamp duty on international companies); (3) apply to VRCA for VAT registration under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 343] on the standard VRCA form when the IC makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu and annual taxable turnover exceeds VT 10,000,000, or electively below that threshold; (4) obtain from VRCA the VAT registration number / TIN and, where goods are imported or exported, register on the VRCA ASYCUDA World electronic customs declaration platform; (5) for an ESOP trust business, confine all trustee, administration, payroll, and equity-transfer services to non-resident employers, grantors, and beneficiaries so that the IC retains its tax-exempt and zero-rated offshore character.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no income tax statute and therefore no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election comparable to US or EU regimes; the relevant statutory elections are (i) voluntary VAT registration below the VT 10,000,000 threshold under the VAT Act, (ii) election to convert or re-domicile an exempted domestic company as an International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222], thereby acquiring the statutory tax exemption guarantee, and (iii) optional application for a Financial Dealers or Securities Dealer licence under the Financial Dealers Licensing Act [Cap. 70] where custody or dealing in employer securities exceeds the IC's exempt activity perimeter; none of these elections alters the entity-level zero-tax classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Value Added Tax) under the Value Added Tax Act No. 26 of 1998 [Cap. 343], as amended
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 10,000,000 annual taxable turnover (mandatory registration when cumulative taxable turnover in any consecutive 12-month period exceeds VT 10,000,000; voluntary registration permitted below the threshold for an IC making taxable supplies in Vanuatu)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time electronic invoicing, fiscal clearance, API interconnection, or digital stamping mandate is currently operative in Vanuatu; VAT invoices must contain the prescribed particulars under the VAT Act and are issued in paper or PDF form; exported goods and customs declarations are lodged electronically through the VRCA ASYCUDA World single-window declaration system, which generates the electronic Customs Export Declaration required for exit clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating under section 10 of the Value Added Tax Act applies to (i) goods exported from Vanuatu physically removed within the statutory timeframe and evidenced by customs documentation, and (ii) services supplied to a non-resident person for direct use and enjoyment outside Vanuatu, including offshore administration, trustee, payroll, and equity-transfer services rendered by an ESOP trust to non-resident employers, grantors, and beneficiaries; the supplier must hold valid VAT registration, issue a compliant tax invoice, retain proof of export or offshore service performance, and receive consideration in foreign currency from outside Vanuatu; domestic supply of trustee services to Vanuatu-resident beneficiaries is taxable at 15% and would erode the IC tax-exempt character.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: VRCA Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World electronic declaration bearing exit clearance stamp)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export of goods
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing receipt of consideration from the non-resident payor
Commercial invoice, export contract, and VAT zero-rating schedule
VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, annual return receipt, and valid International Company certificate for the ESOP trust
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu imposes no exchange-control repatriation rules; the 180-day benchmark is adopted as a default audit tolerance. On review, VRCA may assess unpaid VAT at 15% on the full consideration where zero-rating documentation is defective, add statutory interest, and impose civil penalties under the VAT Act (fines up to VT 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 12 months for fraudulent evasion or false declarations); false customs declarations trigger penalties and forfeiture under the Customs Act [Cap. 145]; refunds previously paid on zero-rated export supplies are retrospectively clawed back with statutory interest, and VFSC may suspend or strike off an IC for inconsistent offshore trust activity.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act (Cap. 125), is the central bank and exchange-control administrator. In practice, exchange control for international companies is waived: Section 56 of the International Companies Act (Cap. 222) exempts every International Company from the operation of the Exchange Control Act (Cap. 102). The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) supervises trust companies, financial dealers and the financial services industry supporting ESOP treasury operations, but holds no monetary authority.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Vatu (VUV) is legal tender and convertible for current-account transactions; the capital account is liberalised for offshore-licensed and International Company structures. A VU-IC ESOP trust has full freedom to hold, convert and remit foreign currency without prior RBV approval. Profit and capital repatriation (dividend, redemption, trust distribution, employee proceeds) is unrestricted and carries zero withholding tax because Vanuatu levies no income tax, no capital gains tax and no remittance tax. The practical friction is limited offshore VUV liquidity; ESOP funding and disbursements are normally transacted in USD or a group base currency through Port Vila correspondent banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable to a VU-IC ESOP trust. Section 56 of the International Companies Act (Cap. 222) excludes International Companies from the Exchange Control Act (Cap. 102); therefore no statutory timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio and no surrender obligation attach to ESOP receipts, employer contributions or investment sale proceeds. Domestic Vanuatu exporters are also subject to a liberalised RBV reporting regime rather than a fixed surrender ratio; an IC enjoys a stricter statutory exemption than domestic entities.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account - USD denominated demand deposit for ESOP contributions, share purchase settlement and employee benefit payouts
Trust Administration Account - multi-currency operational account for the ESOP trustee
Corporate Operational Account - closed-loop account for employer contributions and member distributions
Local Currency Operational Account - VUV account for domestic employee settlements only

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low to Medium. No Vanuatu-licensed standalone electronic money institution (EMI) exists; offshore digital EMIs (UK, EU, Australian and Singapore-based) generally classify Vanuatu International Companies as higher-risk offshore jurisdictions and reject pure IC non-licensed structures, especially for holding or disbursing employee equity funds. Account approval is materially improbable unless the EMI accepts a VFSC-licensed trust company as the onboarding agent and the account is used only for low-velocity outbound benefit payments with strict source-of-funds files. An EMI may be used as a satellite disbursement rail for individual employee payments under USD 10,000 per transaction, but the core treasury should remain with ANZ Vanuatu or BSP Vanuatu commercial banking lines.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Neither ANZ nor BSP mandates statutory physical board attendance; both permit remote onboarding through a VFSC-registered agent or licensed introducer. Each director, the corporate trustee and the ultimate beneficial owners must provide notarised or consular-attested identification plus a live video KYC interview with the bank relationship manager. A physical visit by at least one authorised signatory or the registered agent to Port Vila is strongly recommended and will compress approval from roughly 6-8 weeks to 2-3 weeks. Full remote opening is permissible for a low-risk ESOP trust with OECD-resident beneficiaries when the applying agent indemnifies and files a Financial Dealers License current status certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Discretionary trust opacity: named corporate trustee but unnamed discretionary beneficiaries, preventing the bank from mapping ownership for suspicious-transaction reporting obligations.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of the full Trust Deed and any amending deeds, the Letter of Wishes, a completed Schedule of Beneficial Owners under the Companies and Trust (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations, and a written covenant to update the schedule within 14 days of any beneficiary change.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of funds: employer wires large funding amounts into the ESOP without demonstrable payroll, share plan or board-approval linkage.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Employer board resolutions approving consecutive plan funding, the globally signed ESOP plan document, audited or management accounts of the grantor employer, monthly payroll/vesting schedules, and a funds-flow narrative memo covering every contribution above USD 1,000,000.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border equity transfers: the trust acquires shares of a US or globally listed parent from employees located in multiple jurisdictions without securities-law clearance evidence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Securities-law exemption opinion covering U.S. Rule 701, Regulation S or Form S-8 as applicable, employer share transfer instruments, updated cap table, and local counsel opinions confirming no prospectus obligation in each selling employee's tax residence jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically Exposed Persons (PEP) and sanctions-adjacent beneficiaries: participants resident in high-risk jurisdictions or holding Government-related positions trigger enhanced due diligence and potential account freezing.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed PEP declarations from all directors, trustees and material beneficiaries, independent negative-media and sanctions screening results, certified source-of-wealth statements for each participant, and replacement of any PEP-influenced individual by a VFSC-licensed professional corporate trustee on the board.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing for ESOP funding flows: grantor employer instructs a SWIFT MT103 wire to the VU-IC operating account at ANZ or BSP Port Vila. Recommended ISO 20022 Category Purpose is 'TRUS' (Trust Services) or 'SECU' (Securities Purchase); in SWIFT field 70 include 'ESCO-ESOP EMPLOYEE BENEFIT TRUST CONTRIBUTION / PLAN REF [Plan Name]'. Verification protocol: bank pre-credits only after matching against the employer board resolution, contribution schedule and plan document; funds are screened for sanctions and source-of-funds; remittances from virtual-asset or crypto exchanges are rejected. Instruct charges 'BEN' or 'SHA' and include the VFSC registration number and full beneficiary legal name in field 59 to avoid intermediate-bank rejection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rails for ESOP disbursement: (a) employee purchase-price settlements and option-exercise payments are executed by SWIFT MT103 to individual beneficiaries with purpose codes 'SALA', 'SECU' or 'BONU' depending on the character of payment; (b) trustee-to-custodian equity transfers settle via MT103/MT202 COV together with DVP Euroclear/CREST instructions; (c) intra-group treasury netting uses book-transfer accounting with end-of-day reconciliation. SWIFT MT700 documentary letters of credit are inapplicable to a pure ESOP administration business and should not be established unless the trust deed is amended to permit trade-finance investment; if later required, the LC must be issued through a Vanuatu commercial bank with the RBV reporting waiver noted on the application.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable spot and outright FX forwards (USD/VUV, USD/AUD and USD/EUR) with tenors of 1-12 months executed through the ANZ Vanuatu or BSP Vanuatu dealing rooms

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing VUV or other ESOP benefit currencies via an offshore dealing desk in Hong Kong, Singapore or London for hedging liabilities where local VUV liquidity is thin

Cross-currency swaps (USD to AUD, USD to EUR and USD to GBP) for long-dated employee benefit obligations in the employees' home currencies, entered into as private OTC contracts permitted under Vanuatu law
Plain-vanilla FX options purchased from OECD-located banks to cap employer buy-out cost in the event of VUV volatility spikes; no local exchange-traded derivatives market exists in Vanuatu

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of an International Company (International Companies Act Cap 222, s.82)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after each anniversary of incorporation (fixed anniversary date, not financial year end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of VUV 5,000 per month or part month overdue; returns and fees unpaid for 3+ months expose the IC to Gazette notice and administrative strike-off; reinstatement requires payment of arrears, penalties, and VFSC approval.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation (UBO register filing under the Companies and International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Act 2019)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC Beneficial Ownership Register (lodged by the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the annual return at incorporation anniversary + 60 days; event-driven re-filing within 14 days of every ESOP share transfer or control change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or late UBO data is an offence for the IC and its responsible officers; the agent may withhold compliance certificates, and persistent default constitutes a strike-off ground together with VFSC monetary penalties.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Notification (pure equity-holding entity filing under the Vanuatu economic substance regime)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within the same anniversary + 60-day window as the IC annual return; full substance documentation for relevant activities (not applicable to a passive ESOP trust) within 12 months of financial year end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-filing of the substance notification may attract penalties up to VUV 1,000,000, exchange-of-information referral to the state, and strike-off proceedings against the IC.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory register audit and verification (Register of Members, Register of Directors, and minute books examined and certified by the registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed VFSC registered agent (records kept at the Port Vila registered office for VFSC inspection)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Completed at least annually before signing the annual return; ESOP share allocation and forfeiture entries posted within 14 days of each transaction
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Untrue or deficient registers constitute default penalty offences under Cap 222; unreconciled share registers suspend transfers and entitle the agent to refuse a compliance certificate, triggering VFSC review.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit applies to Vanuatu International Companies; no size, revenue, or asset threshold triggers a mandatory independent audit. An audit is performed only when required by the Articles, resolved by members, or requested by a bank or investor serving the ESOP trust.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed Vanuatu GAAP for ICs; s.47 books may be maintained on IFRS, US GAAP, or a simplified internal accrual basis, provided they fairly reflect transactions and financial position. Financial statements are not filed with VFSC; voluntary audits are rendered under IFRS.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must obtain full UBO particulars (name, date of birth, nationality, residential address, nature and percentage of control) at incorporation and reconfirm them with each annual return. The ESOP trustee must report every share transfer or control change to the agent within 14 days; the agent then updates the VFSC Beneficial Ownership Register and issues an annual UBO confirmation certificate for the IC.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (ESOP participant and trustee shareholdings)
Register of Charges, Mortgages and Encumbrances
Minute Book of Director and Member Resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400-1,500 per annum for licensed VFSC registered agent, registered office, and corporate secretarial maintenance
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not mandatory; voluntary certified audit by a Port Vila CPA firm ranges from USD 1,500 to 4,500 for a low-volume ESOP trust

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, and no branch profits tax; International Companies (ICs) are expressly exempt from any present or future tax on income, dividends, or capital under the International Companies Act (Cap 222), s.46, provided the IC does not carry on business within Vanuatu.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax-exempt zone regime: 0% effective rate for ICs and International Trusts. The only recurring fiscal costs are the VFSC annual registration/license fee and the registered-agent fee, which are administrative levies, not income taxes. Financial-service income of the ESOP trust is treated as an exempt supply for VAT purposes under the Value Added Tax Act; no payroll, property, or inheritance taxes apply to non-resident beneficiaries.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return and Annual License Fee Remittance under the International Companies Act (Cap 222), submitted through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online corporate registry portal; no CIT return exists because Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return and license fee are due within one month after each anniversary of incorporation; the license fee itself is payable on or before the anniversary date of registration of the International Company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the International Company exactly as registered in the VFSC register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the registered English name; no Vanuatu tax calculation attaches to this field because the IC is taxed at 0%.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VFSC company registration number assigned at incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match the certificate of incorporation; a mismatch will delay the annual certificate of good standing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent confirmation: name and address of the licensed Vanuatu registered agent maintaining the registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident beneficial owners may not act as registered agent; the local agent must be licensed under the International Companies Act and will countersign the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Vanuatu where statutory records and accounting records are physically maintained.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominal physical address in Vanuatu is sufficient; all beneficial-owner and accounting data may remain digitally accessible to the agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized and issued share capital, including class of shares, par value, and consideration paid, plus confirmation of ESOP/trust purpose.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Trust shares held by nominee or corporate trustee on behalf of employee beneficiaries; declare in Vatu or USD as recorded at incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current list of directors and the location of the share register.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors may be non-resident; if a corporate director is appointed, its legal form and registered office must be disclosed to the agent but not publicly.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Beneficial ownership confirmation and compliance declaration that the IC has not conducted business within Vanuatu and has not derived income from Vanuatu residents.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident trustees/beneficiaries must file the confidential beneficial-ownership declaration; this field triggers the statutory prohibition on domestic trading.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment of the annual license fee attracts a 25% late-payment surcharge on the outstanding fee plus statutory interest of 10% per annum calculated daily from the due date; failure to file the annual return within the one-month grace period renders the IC liable to administrative default fines, suspension of the certificate of good standing, and involuntary strike-off from the VFSC register if default persists beyond three months; directors are separate strict-liability offenders under the International Companies Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no dividend withholding tax; profits, distributions, and ESOP trust payouts to non-resident beneficiaries are remitted free of any statutory deduction.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement network, and because domestic withholding rates are already nil, no DTA relief claim or tax residency certificate (TRC) is required for outbound distributions. Where a foreign authority demands proof of Vanuatu status, the IC obtains a Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, or incumbency certificate from VFSC; tax information exchange agreements (TIEAs) exist only for administrative cooperation and do not create withholding reductions.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding on cross-border IP royalties and debt interest; treaty rate is irrelevant because no taxing statute exists. Accordingly, an ESOP trust may pay financing interest and licensing fees abroad with zero Vanuatu deduction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no transfer-pricing legislation and prescribes no Local File or Master File threshold (statutory threshold: VUV 0); multinational groups involving a Vanuatu IC must instead satisfy documentation and arm's-length requirements in the foreign parent or operating jurisdiction.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP (Comparable Uncontrolled Price) — persuasive only, not codified
Resale Price Method — persuasive only, not codified
Cost Plus Method — persuasive only, not codified
TNMM (Transactional Net Margin Method) — persuasive only, not codified
Profit Split Method — persuasive only, not codified
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not enact Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) of the BVI/Cayman type. Substance for an International Company is a negative statutory obligation: under s.5 of the International Companies Act the IC must not carry on business with or derive income from Vanuatu residents or domestic sources, and must maintain a registered office, a licensed registered agent, and accounting records. For an ESOP trust, administration may be entrusted to a licensed Vanuatu trust company under the International Trusts Act; foreign tax authorities, not Vanuatu, will apply foreign economic-substance or CFC rules to the trust.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Unauthorised Domestic Commercial Activity
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The IC or ESOP trust derives business income from Vanuatu residents, sells goods or services within Vanuatu, or otherwise trades domestically without a local business license and without registering for VAT under the Value Added Tax Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Ilsant violation of s.5 of the International Companies Act: statutory fine of up to VUV 5,000,000, forced deregistration, compulsory winding-up, and retrospective VAT assessment with a default penalty of up to 200% of the tax evaded.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Knowing directors and trustees are personally liable for civil restitution of all profits derived, are disqualified from acting as directors, face asset-freezing orders and travel bans, and may be imprisoned for up to 12 months under the corporate-offences provisions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing misleading annual returns, using nominee directors without any engagement, failing to maintain accounting records at the registered office, or misrepresenting the absence of Vanuatu-source income to VFSC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine of up to VUV 1,000,000 plus daily default fines; VFSC may strike off the entity without further notice, render its shares void, and disqualify the local registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations incur personal criminal liability, compensation liability to creditors and employee-beneficiaries, and the court may pierce the corporate veil to attach the directors' personal assets.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the ESOP trust to launder proceeds of crime, accepting suspicious contributions from employee-beneficiaries without customer due diligence, structuring transfers to evade foreign exchange controls, or failing to report suspicious transactions to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (VFIU).
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act: corporate fines of up to VUV 100,000,000, confiscation and forfeiture of trust assets, revocation of the trust company's license, and blacklisting of the registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, trustees, and compliance officers face imprisonment of up to 15 years, personal criminal fines, travel bans pending trial, and disqualification orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file or updating the confidential beneficial-ownership declaration with the VFSC central registry, hiding the identity of settlors or ESOP beneficiaries, or providing false information to the registered agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Failure to comply with the beneficial-ownership information law attracts a corporate penalty of up to VUV 1,000,000 and suspension of the IC's good-standing certificate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for fines of up to VUV 500,000 and imprisonment of up to 12 months; the court may impose exit-control orders (travel bans) on non-compliant directors and trustees until the declaration is remedied.
